dog.description_text:
Pop-Up Promo! ACC is over capacity, so I'm currently living in a pop-up crate. My adoption fee is waived, and my adoption comes with a $50 Chewy gift card.

Meet Dream!

Dream may be a little shy at first, but she's hoping her forever home is where all her dreams come true. She takes a little time to warm up and prefers to come to you when she's ready for pets, so she'll appreciate someone who understands that the best relationships are built at her own pace. Give her some patience and a little space, and you might just become her dream come true!

My Ideal Home

Dream would love a calm, patient adopter who will let her take things one step at a time. She's not looking to rush into anything, and she'll need time to feel comfortable in her new surroundings before she's ready to fully come out of her shell.

Good with Other Pets?

Dream's history with other animals is unknown. She was cautious when meeting another dog at ACC and chose to walk away, so any introductions should be slow and respectful.

Good with Kids?

ACC recommends a home without children.

Things to Know

Dream is a gentle, sensitive girl who prefers to make the first move when it comes to affection. She's not quite ready to wake up from her shelter dream just yet, but with the right person, her happily-ever-after could be right around the corner.
dog.name: Dream
